**§1.7 "Services"** means the Fernway platform and related support described in an Order Form**[+, including all Outputs generated by the AI Features+]**.

**§3.2 Payment.** Customer shall pay all invoices within ~~thirty (30)~~ **[+sixty (60)+]** days of receipt.

**§3.4 Renewal Pricing.** Fernway may increase Subscription Fees on renewal by no more than ~~seven percent (7%)~~ **[+three percent (3%)+]** over the prior term's fees.

**§4.2 Termination for Convenience.** Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience on ninety (90) days' written notice. ~~Fees paid or payable for the remainder of the then-current term are non-refundable.~~ **[+Fernway shall refund all prepaid fees attributable to the period following the effective date of termination.+]**

**§5.1 Standard of Care.** Each party shall protect the other's Confidential Information using ~~reasonable care~~ **[+no less than the degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information of like kind, and in no event less than reasonable care+]**.

**§5.4 Survival.** Confidentiality obligations survive for ~~three (3)~~ **[+five (5)+]** years after termination.

**§6.3 Security Incident Notice.** Fernway shall notify Customer of a Security Incident without undue delay, and no later than ~~seventy-two (72)~~ **[+twenty-four (24)+]** hours after discovery.

**§6.4 Audit.** Fernway shall make available its SOC 2 Type II report and penetration-test summary. **[+In addition, Customer and its regulators may conduct an on-site audit of Fernway's facilities, systems, and records relevant to the Services once per year, and at any time following a Security Incident.+]**

**§6.6 Subprocessors.** Fernway shall provide notice of new Subprocessors ~~and Customer may object within thirty (30) days; Customer's sole remedy for an unresolved objection is termination of the affected Services~~ **[+and shall not engage any new Subprocessor without Customer's prior written approval+]**.

**§6.8 Use of Data.** Fernway will not use Customer Content to train or fine-tune any AI model. ~~Fernway may use aggregated, de-identified usage data to operate and improve the Services.~~ **[+Fernway shall not use Customer Data, including any aggregated or de-identified data derived from it, for any purpose other than providing the Services to Customer.+]**

**§8.1 Fernway Indemnity.** Fernway shall defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Services infringe any intellectual property right**[+, and against any losses arising from Fernway's breach of this Agreement, including any fines or penalties imposed by a regulator arising from a Security Incident+]**.

**§9.1 Limitation of Liability.** Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

**§9.2 Super-Cap.** For breach of §5 (Confidentiality), §6 (Data Protection), and Fernway's obligations under §8.1, each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed ~~three (3) times~~ the amount in §9.1. **[+The limitations in this Section 9 shall not apply to breach of §5 or §6, or to any Security Incident.+]**

**§11.1 Governing Law.** This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of ~~New York~~ **[+Delaware+]**.

**§12.6 Insurance.** **[+Fernway shall maintain cyber liability insurance with limits of not less than $10,000,000 per claim and shall name Customer as an additional insured.+]**
